To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the highest antioxidant activity was observed in red grape cultivars (Roesler, Rothray and Swenson Red) and 2) the highest content of stilbenediol was observed in red and pink grape cultivars (Swenson Red, Rothray, Roesler and Cascade).
the content of bioactive components and antioxidant activity of grape cultivars grown in Poland were strongly dependent on the grape color.

the interspecific hybrids of Vitis spp. growing in Poland are characterized by high content of phenolic compounds (especially anthocyanins) and high antioxidant activity, which makes them suitable for production of wines and juices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the first comprehensive evaluation of the chemical and antioxidant potential of 30 grape varieties and hybrids.
the evaluation of chemical properties and antioxidant activity in 30 grape cultivar of white, red, pink and interspecific grape hybrids.
the identification of grape cultivars and hybrids that can be used for the production of wine and grape juice with the highest antioxidant activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
red grapes have the best potential for the production of wine with high antioxidant activity, while white grapes are characterized by a high content of flavonoids.
the studied interspecific hybrids are characterized by higher content of polyphenols, higher antioxidant activity and better fruit quality than V. vinifera cultivars.
the highest content of phenolic compounds and the highest antioxidant activity of grape berries were found in red grape cultivars.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the studied interspecific grape hybrids were characterized by higher content of bioactive phenolic compounds and better antioxidant activity than the popular V. vinifera L cultivars.

the interspecific hybrids of Vitis viniferas L. were not always superior to the popular cultivars of Vitis viniferass L. in terms of fruit quality and chemical properties, but in many cases they were better.
interspecific hybrid cultivars are characterized by a higher content of bioactive polyphenols and antioxidant activity than Vitis viniferas.

the studied interspecific hybrids of V. labrusca × V. vinifera are characterized by higher content of phenolic compounds than V. viniferas, and their antioxidant capacity is similar or slightly higher than the V. viniferal.

the content of phenolic compounds in grapes is highly variable, but the content of total poly-phenols and antioxidant activity of the analyzed cultivars are significantly higher than those of the most popular cultivars of Vitis viniferas grown in Poland.
